parsed.rationale_overall: System B offers stronger personalization by leveraging specific profile attributes (income, expenses, catch-up eligibility, goal priorities) and provides more concrete, executable steps including specific dollar amounts and payroll adjustments. System A has slightly better factual grounding (B's $17k figure for 5% of VTI is inconsistent with portfolio math), but B's broader coverage of inflation hedging and tax-advantaged contributions better addresses the 10-year glide path question.
